title: Obelisk
html:
Obelisks are magical transporters that teleport you to different Obelisks in various Dungeon Outposts and Towns. A player starts with only the Townston Obelisk on their list and the list grows as more Obelisk are discovered and used.


Obelisk Interface

The Obelisk Interface consists of 2 parts: Saved Places and Obelisks

Saved Places

Scroll Waypoint- 
This is the location of the last Waypoint Scroll used. This Scroll Waypoint will disappear if the instance is reset, and the locatiion will change when another Waypoint Scroll is used.
Compass Waypoint- 
This is the location of the last Waypoint Compass used. This Compass Waypoint will change only when another Waypoint Compass is used.
Zone Waypoint- 
This is the location of the last Zone Portal used. This Zone Waypoint will change only when a player goes through a new Zone Portal.

Obelisks

When an new Obelisk is found, its location will be added to the Obelisk list once it has been used for travel. If an Obelisk is NOT used at least once, it will NOT be added to a player's Obelisk List.
